findings.label: Missing payment-waiting fallback in unavailable template
findings.description: customer_receipt_unavailable.html links only to order_tracker. The investigation plan specified a second link to payment_waiting so customers awaiting GCash verification can reach the submission form in one step. Add `Check Payment Status` to the links section.

findings.label: PDF Content-Disposition filename assertion missing .pdf extension
findings.description: test_receipt_pdf_paid_returns_pdf asserts assertIn(f'receipt-{order.order_number}', response['Content-Disposition']) but does not verify the .pdf extension. The assertion passes because order_number never contains '/' (so safe_order_number equals order_number), but tightening to assertIn(f'receipt-{order.order_number}.pdf', ...) would make the intent explicit.
